THE CANON CHANNEL. Dinim, midrashot, Mishnah, deed from one verse; reason-writable judgments vs decreed statutes with both censuses.

source: Sifra, Acharei Mot, Section 8 10 + Chapter 13 12-13 + Onkelos Lev 18:5
claim_en: LIVE BY THEM. Eternal life inside Onkelos's verse; the private-transgress public-sanctify threshold; the gentile-as-high-priest census.
THE FENCE. Gentiles and the woman warned; general-and-particular closing the class; unions underivable by inference; the court on charge.
THE CASE SPLIT. Onkelos parsing the sister clauses into the paternal/maternal cases; the keep-or-send carve.
THE LEVIRATE TABLE. The upon-her bound; fifteen women to the end of the world; the six severer with permitted rivals.

source: Sifra, Acharei Mot, Chapter 13 16-21 + Onkelos Lev 18:25-30
claim_en: THE LAND LEDGER. The opened account book; the vomit physics; exile as the land's liability; the reckoning verb in Onkelos.
